domains.title: Domains or store URLs
domains.description: List of domains or URLs to check (example.com or https://shop.example.ru). Each is fetched once (plus optional contacts page). Free tier: 50 domains per run, up to 500.

includeContactsPage.title: Also fetch /contacts
includeContactsPage.description: When true, each domain also fetches /contacts (best effort) and merges contacts found there.

includeOffer.title: Include the offer record
includeOffer.description: Adds one final record promoting the full sellers chats base (TW1-TG) on Plati.Market.
